reason: A passive DSH plugin that monitors completed turns, records tool-call counts and heuristic verification signals, and persists privacy-minimal summaries locally without executing or validating tests.

summaries.zh: 一个被动监控 DSH 回合执行情况的插件，将工具调用计数和启发式验证信号以隐私最小化摘要写入本地 JSONL 文件。
summaries.en: A passive DSH monitoring plugin that writes privacy-minimal per-turn summaries of tool-call counts and heuristic verification signals to a local JSONL file.

capabilities: Reads durable turn events and temporarily inspects tool names, arguments, and result statuses
Computes heuristic verification signals and hashed session identifiers
Appends privacy-minimal per-turn summaries to a local JSONL file
